body:
Adds `research/closedloop-twin`: a scalar unstable plant identified by least squares from logs of a stabilising controller with dither.

- Exact extrapolation variance `(σ²/n)[(k−k')²/τ² + 1/v]` of the twin's predicted pole under a new gain, matched to simulation.
- Held-out one-step error on same-controller logs is ~1.00σ² at every dither level, so it cannot see the extrapolation error.
- With no dither the minimum-norm fit gets a wrong-sign `b̂` and certifies an unstable gain in 100% of fits.
- False stability certification (point rule vs OLS bound) and the dither budget needed.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (157 projects, 1423 tests). 8 unit tests pass.

Stylised (scalar linear plant, simulated data); see the project README for limitations.
